children: Genasys Inc. (GNSS) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 28, 2026.
On October 28, 2026, the Company issue a press release, which is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1.

The information furnished in this Item 7.01 shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Exchange Act or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall such information be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act, regardless of any general incorporation language in such filing, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/924383/000119312526435239/gnss-20261028.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/924383/000119312526435239/0001193125-26-435239-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
